scenes.line1: How do you handle multiple channels?
scenes.say: Go makes concurrency easy, but how do you wait on many channels at once, or add a timeout?

scenes.label: Select
scenes.sub: Waits on multiple channels, picks one that's ready.
scenes.say: The select statement lets you wait for multiple channel operations and picks whichever is ready first.
Combine select with time dot After to add a timeout. If nothing arrives in time, your code moves on.
Fan-in merges channels. Fan-out splits work. Worker pools use fan-out to process jobs in parallel.

scenes.question: How do you prevent goroutine leaks?
scenes.right: Close the job channel or use context to signal workers to exit cleanly.
scenes.say: Interview trap: letting workers just finish isn't enough. Always close the job channel or use context cancellation to avoid leaks.
